description: A recurring task with three planted failures (OUT_DIR, missing folder, Latin-1 encoding).
prompt: Use the playbook skill. Convert data/export.csv into a Markdown table with tools/convert.py; the result should end up in out/. I have to do this every month with a fresh export, and last time I lost an hour to errors.

assertions.desc: The assistant announces the playbook in one line ('Keeping a playbook for this').
The run log records the attempts, including the encoding and OUT_DIR failures.
The playbook has at least 2 steps ending in 'Done when'.
The playbook's gotchas cover both the encoding and the OUT_DIR failures.
The playbook uses placeholders instead of this run's file name.
Front matter has runs: 1 and status: draft.
